idea-plugin.name: OpenBao Migration Lint
idea-plugin.description:
OpenBao migration check for HashiCorp Vault scripts, Terraform, Helm values and server HCL: 14 rules, each with the OpenBao fix

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → OpenBao Migration Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 14 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/openbao-migration-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/openbao-migration-lint

action.text: OpenBao Migration Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run OpenBao Migration Lint on the file in the editor
